positive.point: Klay Thompson is still playing well and contributing good minutes in Dallas despite the team tanking.
Kevin Durant's time with the Warriors is remembered positively, and he is welcome back anytime.
Steph Curry and Gary Payton II display great charisma and have a fun dynamic, with GP2 being particularly charismatic.
The KP trade is seen as a strategic move for the future, with potential for KP to fit well in the modern game and benefit from the Warriors' medical team.
The idea of resting older players and giving young players more playing time is seen as a hopeful strategy for future success.

negative.point: Jordan Poole's career trajectory has declined since his trade, and his defensive efforts were criticized.
Kevin Durant is perceived to have self-sabotaged his career by leaving the Warriors, missing out on potential championships.
The Warriors' performance post-KP trade has been poor, with a record of 3-8, indicating struggles despite the trade.
The team is unlikely to succeed without Jimmy, highlighting concerns about the team's dependency on him.
